scope: File uploads larger than a MiB on a clean GitHub runner, not a real server, through the gateway to the shared Storage with supabase-js: a 20 MiB file uploaded and downloaded byte for byte, a file just under the 50 MiB default limit accepted and one just over it refused with the next request unaffected; then the same with a 64 MiB limit after a restart that recreated the Storage container. Transcribed from the CI docker-install job 107511100370 (run 35961375429, commit f308654).
